verdict.rationale: Letta is a stateful-agent memory platform, so graph-structured memory is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence describes memory only as Markdown files in a Git-backed MemFS repository, with keyword, semantic or hybrid search through a mod. A Letta employee also says the memory is 'primarily text/files based'. Nothing in the pack documents entity or relationship extraction, a knowledge-graph store, or multi-hop graph queries.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can store memories as a knowledge graph of entities and relationships so multi-hop and entity-centric questions are answerable
